title: Market wrap: Reliance Industries, SBI, Power Grid among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday - The Economic Times
text:
Indian benchmark indices ended mixed as the closing auction session continued distorting market moves. Sensex climbed 374 points while Nifty gained just 11 points. Reliance Industries and SBI led gains, with analysts identifying 24,600 as Nifty’s key support and 24,800 as resistance.
